description: eTOD dataset of aeronautical obstacles is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by NGI - IGN. Vector dataset of aeronautical obstacles with a height of 60 meters or more above the ground. The update of this dataset takes place on a multi-year cycle; for each obstacle and for each location, the situation is indicated as applicable at the time of its last update. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in MSG_HTTP. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Not specified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
